chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 242: Han Li’s Plan to Break the Spirit Stone Bottleneck Through Talisman Crafting
chapter_meta_description: Han Li devises a clever workaround to his resource shortage: using the Heaven Vial to mass-produce talisman paper and craft mid-grade talismans. Four years of seclusion begin.
og_title: RMJI Ch.242 – The Blueprint of a Mortal Stream Mind
og_description: Han Li’s solution to spirit stone poverty: grow herbs, make paper, craft talismans. Also: a mysterious messenger arrives.
twitter_title: RMJI 242 – Han Li becomes a talisman factory
twitter_description: Caught between a spirit stone shortage and his Heaven Vial secret, Han Li chooses the most logical path: become a one-man talisman production line.

lore_anchors.definition: The second major cultivation realm, marking a significant leap in lifespan and magical power; often considered the true beginning of a cultivator's journey.
A rare natural formation of concentrated spiritual qi that can accelerate cultivation speed; Han Li obtained one in a previous chapter.
A high-quality talisman brush given to Han Li by a junior disciple; sufficient for mid-grade talisman crafting.
One of the two ancient formulas Han Li obtained; the ingredients are now gathered.
The high-grade sword cultivation technique Han Li chose after Foundation Establishment; it lacks accompanying magic tools, making talismans a critical supplement.
A dangerous cultivation method that requires dissolving and rebuilding one's foundation; Han Li plans to safeguard himself during the vulnerable reset period with talismans.
A basic magical communication tool that carries a message to a designated recipient; common in xianxia settings.
Medicinal plants infused with spiritual energy, used for alchemy and talisman paper production; their growth rate is the primary constraint in the cultivation economy.
